notes.title: Demo version output
notes.notes:
It was a very long development of the demo version of the game, and we had to postpone the update date for a couple of weeks due to minor improvements, but now we are ready to present the game to you.

 What's new? 
 Added mini-games: snake and Flappy Bird
 Added interactive moments
 Added achievements and highscore table for mini-games
 What has changed?
 The plot of the 2022 game has been completely rewritten
 Completely updated graphics and music
 Completely updated the game menu
 Rewritten the work with modifications and the tools in general


End
Thank you to everyone who continued to believe in us and helped us develop the demo version! We are very excited to finally release the update, but that doesn't mean we won't continue working. Now we are going on a short break and a PR campaign, so we will publish less news and posts in our Discord, VK,  Telegram and Boosty. If you want to help us with the development, you can send a donation to Boosty, DonationAlerts or write to us in the social network in the help offer.

We would also appreciate it if you subscribe to the game and recommend it to your friends (or purchase another copy of the game on other platforms, or subscribe to the Crucial Experiment page on Steam).
